Pashur. Not the Pashur of Jeremiah 20:1 . This prophecy is nineteen years later; the deportation in the reign of Jehoiachin had taken place, and a worse set of men were the rulers. This Pashur was a priest, if Melchiah is the same Melchiah as in 1 Chronicles 9:12 .

Zephaniah, &c. He is mentioned again (Jeremiah 29:25 ; Jeremiah 37:3 ; Jeremiah 52:24 ). The Hebrew accents read "Zephaniah the priest, the son of Maaseiah."

entries.title: the LORD.
entries.content:
the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah . App-4 .

Nebuchadrezzar. First occurrence in Jeremiah.

go up from us: i.e. raise the siege.

entries.title: Zedekiah.
entries.content: Zedekiah. The last king of Judah.

entries.title: the LORD God of Israel
entries.content:
the LORD God of Israel = Jehovah the Elohim of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 11:3 , and App-4 .

Behold. Figure of speech. Asterismos . App-6 .

entries.title: outstretched hand.
entries.content:
outstretched hand. Reference to Pentateuch (Exodus 6:6 )

strong = strong (for holding fast).

entries.title: man.
entries.content: man. Hebrew. 'adam. App-14 .

entries.title: saith the LORD
entries.content:
saith the LORD = [is] Jehovah's oracle.

from. Some codices, with Aramaean, Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "and from", thus forming the Figure of speech Polysyndeton. App-6 .

life = soul. Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 .

he shall not spare. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 28:50 ).

entries.title: I set before you, &c.
entries.content:
I set before you, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 30:19 ).

life . . . death. Note the' Introversion in Jeremiah 21:9 , "die . . . live".

entries.title: he that goeth out, &c.
entries.content:
he that goeth out, &c. Many acted on this promise (Jeremiah 39:9 ; Jeremiah 52:15 ).

falleth = shall fall.

he shall live. Some codices, with two early printed editions, read "then (or so) shall he live".

be unto him for a prey: i.e. he shall save his life, but it will be dearly bought. Compare Jeremiah 38:2 ; Jeremiah 39:18 ; Jer 45:6 . The phrase occurs only in Jeremiah.

entries.title: I have set, &c.
entries.content:
I have set, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Leviticus 17:10 ). Compare Ezekiel 15:7 .

evil = calamity. Hebrew. ra'a'. App-44 .

entries.title: house of David.
entries.content:
house of David. Occurs only here in Jeremiah.

in the morning = betimes.

evil. Hebrew. ra'a'. App-44 .

your. Some codices, with seven early printed editions, read "their".

entries.title: inhabitant
entries.content:
inhabitant = inhabitress: i.e. Zion.

rock of the plain. Figure of speech Periphrasis , for Zion.

entries.title: kindle a fire, &c.
entries.content:
kindle a fire, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 32:22 ). App-92 .

the forest thereof = her forest. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Cause), App-6 , for the timber from Lebanon used in the buildings.

it shall devour. Fulfilled in Jeremiah 52:13 .

entries.title: the LORD.
entries.content:
the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

Go down. Compare Jeremiah 36:12 .

king of Judah: i.e. Jehoiakim.

entries.title: Execute ye, &c.
entries.content:
Execute ye, &c. See note on Jeremiah 7:5 .

judgment and righteousness. Figure of speech Hendiadys = judgment, yea, righteous judgment.

spoiled = robbed.

no. nor. neither. Note the Figure of speech Paradiastole .

stranger = sojourner.

fatherless, nor the widow. Put by Figure of speech Synecdoche (of Species), for all afflicted ones.

innocent blood. See note on Jeremiah 7:6 .

entries.title: upon the throne of David
entries.content:
upon the throne of David = for David upon his throne.

servants. Hebrew text reads "servant", but some codices, with two early printed editions, read plural, as in Authorized Version.

entries.title: saith the LORD
entries.content: saith the LORD = [is] Jehovah's oracle.

entries.title: house of Judah.
entries.content: house of Judah. See note on Jeremiah 3:18 .

entries.title: prepare
entries.content:
prepare = set apart. Compare Jeremiah 6:4 ; Jeremiah 51:27 , Jeremiah 51:28 .

cedars. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Cause), for the houses built of cedar.

entries.title: Wherefore . . . ?
entries.content: Wherefore . . . ? Reference to Pentateuch. See note on Jeremiah 16:10 .

entries.title: the dead:
entries.content:
the dead: i.e. Josiah.

him: i.e. Jehoiachin.

weep sore = weep ye, weep on. Figure of speech Polyptoton. App-6 .

entries.title: Shallum the son of Josiah.
entries.content: Shallum the son of Josiah. Josiah had four sons (1 Chronicles 3:15 ). Shallum had another name Jehoahaz. Compare 2 Kings 23:31 , 2 Kings 23:34 . Zedekiah must have been younger than Jehoiakim or Jehoahaz, for he was but twenty-one when he began to reign, and therefore only ten when Jehoiakim began to reign.

entries.title: die in the place, &c.
entries.content: die in the place, &c. i.e. in Egypt. He was the first king of Israel to do so. 2 Kings 23:34 .

entries.title: chambers
entries.content:
chambers = upper chambers.

by wrong = in injustice.

useth his neighbour's service, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Leviticus 19:13 ).

work. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Cause), for the wages earned by his labour = giveth him not [wages] for his work.

entries.title: large
entries.content:
large = airy, or roomy.

windows = its windows.

cieled = panelled.

entries.title: justice
entries.content: justice = righteousness, as in Jeremiah 22:3 .

entries.title: He:
entries.content:
He: i.e. Josiah.

judged the cause. Figure of speech Polyptoton. Hebrew judged the judgment. Figure of speech Erotesis by Ellipsis = "[Did he not] judge righteous judgment? "Figure of speech Hendiadys, as in Jeremiah 22:3 .

poor = wretched. Hebrew. 'anah. See note on "poverty", Proverbs 6:11 .

entries.title: But thine eyes:
entries.content: But thine eyes: or, Verily, thou hast neither eyes nor heart save for, &c.

entries.title: buried with the burial of an ass.
entries.content:
buried with the burial of an ass. Note the Figure of speech Oxymoron , which gives the meaning that he was not buried at all (for asses have no funerals). Jehoiakim is the only king of Judah whose burial is not recorded. See note on 2 Kings 24:6 .

drawn, &c.: i.e. the ass, not Jehoiakim (Jeremiah 22:26 ).

cast forth. Compare Isaiah 26:19 .

entries.title: Go up, &c.
entries.content:
Go up, &c. Note the Figure of speech Eironeia. App-6 .

cry: the cry of distress.

the passages = Abarim: the mountains beyond Jordan, the range of Nebo. Compare Numbers 27:12 ; Numbers 33:47 , Numbers 33:48 .

lovers: i.e. the neighbouring nations, to whom they looked instead of to God.

entries.title: prosperity.
entries.content:
prosperity. Hebrew, plural of majesty = thy great prosperity.

obeyedst not = hearkenedst not to.

entries.title: wind.
entries.content:
wind. Hebrew. ruach. App-9 .

pastors. Put for rulers of all kinds. See notes on Jeremiah 2:8 ; Jeremiah 3:15 , &c.

wickedness. Hebrew. ra'a'. App-44 . Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Cause), for the cause of the calamity.

entries.title: O.
entries.content:
O. Figure of speech Apostrophe.

inhabitant = inhabitress: i.e. Zion.

Lebanon. Figure of speech Metalepsis : "Lebanon" put for the cedars grown there, then "cedars" put for the houses built of the timber.

how gracious = how greatly to be pitied.

entries.title: Coniah
entries.content:
Coniah = (by Figure of speech Aphaeresis) , by which the first syllable is cut off. He is called "Jeconiah" (1 Chronicles 3:16 ), which means "Let Jehovah establish"; but the cutting off of the Divine name "Je" (for Jah or Jehovah) is meant to show the departure of Jehovah from Jeconiah, and that he himself would be cut off.

signet. Compare Haggai 2:23 .

right hand. Figure of speech Anthropopatheia.

entries.title: desire to return
entries.content: desire to return = are lifting up their soul. Hebrew. nephesh.

entries.title: man.
entries.content: man. Hebrew. 'ish. App-14 .

entries.title: earth, earth, earth.
entries.content: earth, earth, earth. Figure of speech Epizeuxis , for great emphasis.

entries.title: childless:
entries.content:
childless: i.e. as to the throne (see last clause). Not one of his seven sons (1 Chronicles 3:17 , 1 Chronicles 3:18 ) sat upon his throne.

a man = a strong man. Hebrew. geber. App-14 .

entries.title: the pastors
entries.content:
the pastors = rulers. See notes on Jeremiah 2:8 ; Jeremiah 3:15 , &c.

saith the LORD = [is] Jehovah's oracle.

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

entries.title: the LORD God of Israel.
entries.content:
the LORD God of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 11:3 .

God. Hebrew. Elohim.

that feed = that are the feeders of. Figure of speech Antimereia (of the Verb).

behold. Figure of speech Asterismos. App-6 .

I will visit, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Exodus 32:34 ).

evil. Hebrew ra'a.

entries.title: I will gather, &c.
entries.content: I will gather, &c. Compare Jeremiah 31:10 ; Jeremiah 32:7 . Ezekiel 34:13 , &c.

entries.title: Branch
entries.content:
Branch = Sprout from the root, not from a branch. Compare Isaiah 11:1 ; Isaiah 53:2 . Here, Hebrew. zemach. The name of the brightest star in the Zodiac sign "Virgo". See App-12 . See notes on the Structure of the Four Gospels. Compare Jeremiah 33:15 .

King. See the Structure of the Gospels. Matthew. Compare Isaiah 9:6 , Isaiah 9:7 . Zechariah 6:12 , Zechariah 6:13 .Psalms 72:2 .Luke 1:32 .

judgment and justice. See note on Jeremiah 22:3 .

entries.title: Israel shall dwell safely.
entries.content:
Israel shall dwell safely. Reference to Pentateuch (Leviticus 25:18 , Leviticus 25:19 ; Leviticus 25:26 , Leviticus 25:5 .Deuteronomy 33:12 , Deuteronomy 33:28 . Repeated in Jeremiah 32:37 ; Jeremiah 33:16 ). App-92 .

THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS. Hebrew. Jehovah Zidkenu. See App-4 . For the reason of the large type in Authorized Version, see App-48 .

OUR. Because the gift of God.

entries.title: the days come.
entries.content:
the days come. Compare Jeremiah 16:14 , Jeremiah 16:15 .

Which brought up, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Ex. Jeremiah 12:15 , &c). App-92 .

children = sons.

entries.title: the house of Israel.
entries.content:
the house of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 2:4 .

land = soil.

entries.title: Mine heart, &c.
entries.content:
Mine heart, &c. Figure of speech Pathopoeia.

man. Hebrew. 'ish.

a man = a strong man. Hebrew. geber. App-14 .

wine. Hebrew. yayin. App-27 .

entries.title: their:
entries.content: their: i.e. the false prophets.

entries.title: wickedness.
entries.content: wickedness. Hebrew. ra'a'. App-44 .

entries.title: the year of their visitation.
entries.content: the year of their visitation. See note on Jeremiah 8:12 .

entries.title: the LORD of hosts
entries.content: the LORD of hosts = Jehovah Zebaioth. See note on Jeremiah 6:6 and 1 Samuel 1:3 .

entries.title: They say still.
entries.content:
They say still. Figure of speech Polyptoton. Hebrew = saying they say = keep on saying.

imagination = stubbornness.

entries.title: who . . . ?
entries.content:
who . . . ? Figure of speech Erotesis. Implying that none hath.

counsel = secret council. Compare Psalms 25:14 .

His. Hebrew text, with Revised Version, reads "My"; but margin of Hebrew text, the Babylonian Codex, with eight early printed editions, Aramaean, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "His'! with Authorized Version.

heard: or, announced. Compare Jeremiah 23:22 .

entries.title: fall grievously
entries.content:
fall grievously = burst.

the wicked = lawless ones.

entries.title: the latter days
entries.content:
the latter days = end of days. Reference to Pentateuch (Genesis 49:1 , the same word). App-92 .

perfectly. Compare Jeremiah 30:24 .

entries.title: I have not, &c.
entries.content: I have not, &c. Compare Jeremiah 23:32 ; Jeremiah 14:14 .

entries.title: But if, &c.
entries.content: But if, &c. The Hebrew accent requires the rendering: "But, had they stood in My Council: then they would have made My People hear My words, and they would have turned", &c.

entries.title: Am I . . . ?
entries.content:
Am I . . . ? Figure of speech Erotesis. App-6 .

and not, &c. Figure of speech Pleonasm , for emphasis.

entries.title: Can . . . ? . . . Do . . . ?
entries.content:
Can . . . ? . . . Do . . . ? Figure of speech E rotesis.

fill. The Hebrew accent (" Tiphcha' ") puts the emphasis on "fill" (not on "earth"), denoting the fullness of the Divine presence which no place can in clude, or ex clude. A fullness of grace, of the prophetic word of judgment, and of promise.

entries.title: I have dreamed.
entries.content: I have dreamed. Thus catching the people's ears. Note Figure of speech Epizeuxis. App-6 .

entries.title: How long . . . ?
entries.content:
How long . . . ? Figure of speech Erotesis.

shall this be = shall this exist. Hebrew. yesh. See notes on Jeremiah 31:6 , Jeremiah 31:16 , Jeremiah 31:17 . Proverbs 8:21 ; Proverbs 18:24 , and Luke 7:25 .

entries.title: as
entries.content:
as = according as.

for = in, or through.

entries.title: he that hath, &c.
entries.content:
he that hath, &c. Compare Ezekiel 13:7 .

chaff = crushed, or chopped straw. Hebrew. teben.

entries.title: Is not . . . ?
entries.content: Is not . . . ? Figure of speech Erotesis.

entries.title: I am against, &c.
entries.content: I am against, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 18:20 ).

entries.title: say, He saith
entries.content: say, He saith = uttered it as an oracle. Hebrew. ne'um. Reference to Pentateuch (Genesis 22:16 . Numbers 14:28 ; Numbers 24:3 , Numbers 24:4 , Numbers 24:15 , Numbers 24:16 ). Frequent in the prophets.

entries.title: lightness
entries.content: lightness = reckless boasting.

entries.title: What burden?
entries.content:
What burden? Septuagint, Vulgate, and Rashi, read "Ye yourselves are the burden". Compare Jeremiah 23:36 .

forsake = reject.

entries.title: perverted.
entries.content:
perverted. See note on Jeremiah 6:10 .

the living God. Both words are plural.

entries.title: ye say
entries.content: ye say = ye keep on saying. Figure of speech Polyptoton. App-6 .

entries.title: everlasting . . . perpetual.
entries.content: everlasting . . . perpetual. Put by Figure of speech Synecdoche (of the Whole), for a part of time = life long. Limited here by the promised Restoration.

entries.title: The LORD.
entries.content:
The LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

shewed me = made me see.

behold. Figure of speech Asterismos. App-6 .

baskets. Hebrew. dudim. Still used for fruit in Jerusalem.

the temple. See note on Jeremiah 26:2 .

carpenters and smiths = craftsmen (or artificers) and armourers.

entries.title: naughty
entries.content: naughty = worth naught.

entries.title: evil.
entries.content: evil. Hebrew. raa'. App-44 . Compare Jeremiah 29:17 .

entries.title: Jeremiah's Fifteenth Prophecy
entries.content:
Jeremiah's Fifteenth Prophecy (see book comments for Jeremiah).

the LORD, the God of Israel = Jehovah Elohim of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 11:3 and App-4 .

acknowledge = own. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Cause), App-6 , for regard, or care for.

for . . . good. Connect this with "acknowledge", not with "sent out".

entries.title: For I will set Mine eyes
entries.content:
For I will set Mine eyes = And I will set Mine eye. Some codices, with Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "eyes" (plural) with Authorized Version.

build . . . plant. Compare Jeremiah 1:10 ; Jeremiah 18:7-9 .

entries.title: I will give, &c.
entries.content:
I will give, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 30:6 ).

they shall be My People. Reference to Pentateuch (Leviticus 26:12 ).

entries.title: to be removed into
entries.content:
to be removed into = to be tossed to and fro among.

be removed. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 28:25 ). App-92 .

for their hurt. Hebrew. raa'. App-44 . Compare Jeremiah 25:6 ; Jeremiah 38:4 .

to be a reproach = [I will deliver them to be] a reproach.

a taunt. Reference to Pentateuch. Some codices, with two early printed editions, Aramaean, Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulg, read "and a", thus completing the Figure of speech Polysyndeton ( App-6 ).

entries.title: the sword, the famine, and the pestilence.
entries.content:
the sword, the famine, and the pestilence. Reference to Pentateuch (Leviticus 26:25 , Leviticus 26:26 . Deuteronomy 28:21-24 ). App-92 .

the famine. Some codices, with one early printed edition, Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "and famine", thus completing the Figure of speech Polysyndeton .

land = soil, or ground. Hebrew. 'adamah.

entries.title: Jeremiah's Sixteenth Prophecy
entries.content:
Jeremiah's Sixteenth Prophecy (see book comments for Jeremiah).

to. Hebrew "upon". Some codices, with two early printed editions, Septuagint, and Vulgate, read "unto".

all the People = the People at large.

the fourth year of Jehoiakim. An important date, being the first year of Nebuchadnezzar. See App-83 and App-86 .

the first year, &c. See App-86 .

Nebuchadrezzar. Compare Jeremiah 21:2 .

Babylon. Assyria not mentioned, for it had already fallen.

entries.title: Jeremiah the prophet spake.
entries.content:
Jeremiah the prophet spake. This is the first occurrence of the expression. We find "said" later; and "prophet" in Jeremiah 1:5 ; Jeremiah 20:2 ; Jeremiah 28:5 , Jeremiah 28:6 , Jeremiah 28:10 , Jeremiah 28:11 , Jeremiah 28:12 , Jeremiah 28:12 , Jeremiah 28:15 ; Jeremiah 29:1 , Jeremiah 29:29 ; Jeremiah 32:2 ; Jeremiah 36:8 , &c, Jeremiah 34:6 ; Jeremiah 45:1 .

spake. In Ch. Jeremiah 36:2 he is told to "write", because "Israel" (being dispersed), could not be spoken to, as Judah was here.

entries.title: thirteenth year of Josiah.
entries.content:
thirteenth year of Josiah. Compare Jeremiah 1:2 .

the three and twentieth year: i.e. of Jeremiah's prophesying: 18 years under Josiah + 3 months under Jehoahaz + 4 years under Jehoiakim.

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

rising early and speaking. See note on Jeremiah 7:13 .

entries.title: evil
entries.content:
evil = calamity. Hebrew. ra'a. App-44 .

in the land = on the soil. Hebrew. 'adamah.

for ever and ever = from age to age. This must be read with "given", and refers to God's counsel. See note on Isaiah 44:7 ("ancient").

entries.title: do you no hurt
entries.content:
do you no hurt = bring no calamity upon you.

hurt. Hebrew. ra'a'. App-44 . Compare Jeremiah 25:5 .

entries.title: saith the LORD
entries.content:
saith the LORD = [is] Jehovah's oracle.

provoke Me to anger, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 32:21 ).

entries.title: the LORD of hosts.
entries.content: the LORD of hosts. See note on Jeremiah 6:6 , and 1 Samuel 1:3 .

entries.title: My servant.
entries.content:
My servant. Compare Isaiah 45:1 .

and. Note the Figure of speech Polysyndeton. App-6 .

astonishment. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 28:37 ). Compare Jeremiah 25:18 .

perpetual = age-abiding. Put by Figure of speech Synecdoche (of the Whole), for a long time.

entries.title: I will take from them.
entries.content:
I will take from them. Quoted in Revelation 18:23 . Compare Jeremiah 7:34 ; Jeremiah 16:9 ; Jeremiah 33:11 .

candle = lamp.

entries.title: and.
entries.content:
and. Some codices, with three early printed editions, Syriac, and Vulgate, read this "and" in the text.

seventy years. From 496 to 426. See the special note on 2 Chronicles 36:21 .

entries.title: when.
entries.content:
when. No necessary sequence with Jeremiah 25:11 .Jeremiah 25:12; Jeremiah 25:12 commences a fresh paragraph about the seventy years.

punish = visit upon, exactly seventy years later.

iniquity. Hebrew. 'avah. App-44 .

it. Hebrew masculine = the People rather than the land.

entries.title: of them:
entries.content: of them: i.e. of the Chaldeans.

entries.title: the LORD God of Israel.
entries.content:
the LORD God of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 11:3 .

wine. Hebrew. yayin. App-27 .

entries.title: be moved
entries.content:
be moved = reel to and fro.

because of the sword, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Leviticus 26:25 , Leviticus 26:33 ). App-92 .

entries.title: Jerusalem.
entries.content:
Jerusalem. Comes first (Compare Jeremiah 25:29 ), because of 1 Peter 4:17 . Amos 3:2 .

and. So some codices, with five early printed editions, Aramaean, Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate. Others omit this "and".

as it is this day. Probably added by Jeremiah when this prophecy had been fulfilled.

entries.title: mingled people.
entries.content:
mingled people. Hebrew. 'ereb. Compare Jeremiah 50:37 . Ezekiel 30:5 .Daniel 2:43 .Ezra 9:2 .Psalms 106:35 . In the inscription of Sennacherib (Bellino's Cylinder, line 13) the Urbi are joined with the Arameans (nomad tribes west of the Euphrates). Sennacherib says that Hezekiah had some " Urbi" soldiers with him in Jerusalem.

Uz. Job's country near Idumea (Lamentations 4:2 .)

Philistines, &c. Compare Jeremiah 47 .

Ashkelon. Now 'Askalan. Azzah. Hebrew ' Azz ah = Gaza.

Ekron. Now ' Aki r.

Ashdod. Now 'Esdud.

entries.title: children
entries.content: children = sons.

entries.title: and the kings.
entries.content:
and the kings. So in the Mugah Codex (quoted in the Massorah) ; but other codices, with one early printed edition, read "and all the kings".

isles = coast-land, or maritime country.

are. Supply "is", referring to coast-land.

entries.title: Dedan.
entries.content:
Dedan. On the borders of Edom (Jeremiah 49:8 . Ezekiel 25:13 ).

Tema, and Buz. The country of Elihu. See Job 32:2 and note on p. 666.

that are in the utmost corners = all with their hair clipped at the corners.

entries.title: the world.
entries.content:
the world. Hebrew. 'erez (with Art.), the earth.

the earth = the ground, or soil. Hebrew. 'adamah (with Art.)

Sheshach. The Massorah explains that this word is "Babel", being a cypher by which the last letter of the alphabet is put for the first, and the next to the last for the second, &c., by which Sh. Sh. Ch. becomes B. B. L. "Babel" (CompareJeremiah 51:41; Jeremiah 51:41 , where both words are used). There is another example in Jeremiah 51:1 . See note there. Four classes of nations are to drink of this cup of the fury of Jehovah Elohim of Israel (Jeremiah 25:15 ): (1) Jerusalem and Judah (Jeremiah 25:18 ); (2) Egypt, &c. (Jeremiah 25:19 ); (3) the mingled nations (verses: 20-22); and (4) the more distant nations (vv- 23-25). Daniel fills in these "times of the Gentiles", which are not within the scope of Jeremiah and Ezekiel. But the point here is that the final judgment of the nations is yet future: when "Great Babylon" comes into remembrance, it will "drink after them". Compare Jeremiah 49:12 . For this, "Sheshach" must be rebuilt and restored.

the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 7:3 .

entries.title: which is called by My name
entries.content:
which is called by My name = upon which My name is called.

unpunished = held guiltless. Compare 1 Peter 4:17 . Reference to Pentateuch (Exodus 20:7 ; Exodus 34:7 . Numbers 14:18 ).

the earth. Hebrew. ha'arez. Same word as "the world" in Jeremiah 25:26 .

entries.title: roar.
entries.content:
roar. Compare Jeremiah 25:38 , "as a lion".

holy. See Exodus 3:5 .

upon His habitation = against His fold.

the grapes = the winepress. Compare Isaiah 63:1-6 .

entries.title: plead with
entries.content:
plead with = judge.

wicked = lawless. Hebrew. rasha'. App-44 .

entries.title: coasts
entries.content: coasts = sides: i.e. uttermost parts. earth. Hebrew. 'arez. Compare Jeremiah 25:29 .

entries.title: the slain.
entries.content: the slain. By the sword. Compare Isaiah 66:16 .

entries.title: shepherds
entries.content:
shepherds = rulers (of all kinds). Compare Jeremiah 2:8 ; Jeremiah 6:3 . All three had miserable ends: Jehoiakim (Jeremiah 22:18 ; Jeremiah 36:30 ); Jehoiachin, taken to Babylon; and Zedekiah, after his eyes were put out.

principals = strong ones.

of your dispersions: or, when ye are dispersed. So in the Mugah Codex (quoted in the Massorah), with three early printed editions.

pleasant = precious (i.e. fair, but fragile).

entries.title: peaceable habitations
entries.content:
peaceable habitations = pastures of peace.

cut down = silenced.

entries.title: as the lion.
entries.content:
as the lion. Figure of speech Simile ( App-6 ). Compare Jeremiah 25:30 .

the fierceness of the oppressor. Some codices, with one early printed edition, Aramaean, and Septuagint, read "the (Septuagint "great") sword of oppressors". Compare Jeremiah 46:16 ; Jeremiah 50:16 .

entries.title: Jeremiah's Seventeenth Prophecy
entries.content:
Jeremiah's Seventeenth Prophecy (see book comments for Jeremiah).

In the beginning: i.e. before the siege, in the third year of Jehoiakim. See note on Jeremiah 27:1 .

The first edition of the Prophets (Naples, 1485-6), the first edition of the entire Hebrew Bible (Soncino 1488), and the second edition (Naples, 1491-3), introduce the word hazi = half, here, to indicate that the second half of Jeremiah commences here.

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

entries.title: in the court.
entries.content:
in the court. This was Jeremiah's most public utterance. Compare Jeremiah 7:2 .

cities. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Subject), for their inhabitants.

diminish not a word. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 4:2 ; Deuteronomy 12:32 ). App-92 . The importance of this is seen from the note on Jeremiah 26:18 .

entries.title: every man.
entries.content:
every man. Hebrew. 'ish.

evil. Hebrew. ra'a'.

repent Me. Figure of speech Anthropopatheia. App-6 .

entries.title: If ye will not hearken.
entries.content:
If ye will not hearken. Reference to Pentateuch (Leviticus 26:14 .Deuteronomy 28:15; Deuteronomy 28:15 ). App-92 .

My law. Reference to Pentateuch (Exodus 20 ).

entries.title: both
entries.content:
both = even. Some codices, with one early printed edition, Aramaean, Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, omit this "even".

rising up early, &c. See note on Jeremiah 7:13 .

entries.title: Shiloh.
entries.content:
Shiloh. See note on Jeremiah 7:12 .

a curse. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Adjunct), for the subject of cursing. Compare Jeremiah 29:22 .

entries.title: unto.
entries.content:
unto. One school of Massorites ( App-30 ) reads "concerning".

Thou shalt surely die. This was in accordance with Deuteronomy 18:20 , as they would not believe that Jehovah could send such a message. A reference to Pentateuch (Genesis 2:17 ). App-92 . Jeremiah's danger was very real. Compare Jeremiah 26:20-24 .

entries.title: all.
entries.content: all. Put by Figure of speech Synecdoche (of Genus), for most of the People.

entries.title: new gate.
entries.content:
new gate. The Targum takes this to be the east gate.

house. Some codices, with Aramaean, Syriac, and Vulgate, read this word "house" in the text.

entries.title: This man is worthy to die
entries.content:
This man is worthy to die = Death's judgment is for this man: "judgment" being put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of the Cause), for the effect of it: viz. the sentence of death (idiomatically rendered in Authorized Version.) Compare John 3:19 , where krisis is put for the act or process of judging. See App-85 .

man. Hebrew. 'ish. App-14 .

as = according as.

entries.title: obey
entries.content:
obey = listen to.

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

entries.title: innocent blood.
entries.content: innocent blood. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 19:10 , Deuteronomy 19:13 ). App-92 . Compare Matthew 27:4 , Matthew 27:25 .Luke 23:13-15 . See App-85 .

entries.title: Then said the princes, &c.
entries.content:
Then said the princes, &c. In favour of Jeremiah. Note the Structure, p. 1053.

This man, &c. See App-85 .

man. Hebrew. 'ish. App-14 .

entries.title: certain
entries.content: certain = men. Plural of 'enosh. App-14 . Some better acquainted with affairs than others.

entries.title: Micah.
entries.content:
Micah. The prophet whose book is called after his name. Contemporary with Hosea and Amos in Israel, and with Isaiah in Judah. See App-77 .

the LORD of hosts. See note on Jeremiah 6:6 . 1 Samuel 1:3 .

Zion shall be plowed, &c. See note on Micah 3:12 . A prophecy which was wholly fulfilled as to the Jewish Zion (south of Moriah), but not as to the traditional Zion, south-west of Jerusalem. See App-68 .

entries.title: the LORD.
entries.content:
the LORD. Hebrew 'eth Jehovah = Jehovah Himself.

besought the LORD = appeased the face of Jehovah. Figures of speech Pleonasm and Anthropopatheia.

repented Him. Figure of speech Anthropopatheia. App-6 . Reference to Pentateuch (Exodus 32:14 ). App-92 .

souls. Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 .

entries.title: And
entries.content:
And = But. Said in reply to the friends of Jeremiah by his adversaries. See the Structure above.

Urijah. This incident is not recorded in the historical books, but it illustrates Jeremiah 26:5 .

Kirjath-jearim. Now 'Khan 'Erma, or Kuriet el 'Enab, four miles west of the hill overlooking Beth-shemesh, and about twelve miles from Jerusalem.

entries.title: the king sought, &c.
entries.content: the king sought, &c. One of eleven rulers offended with God's messengers. See note on Exodus 10:28 .

entries.title: Elnathan.
entries.content: Elnathan. See Jeremiah 26:22 ; Jeremiah 36:12 , Jeremiah 36:25 .

entries.title: slew him with the sword.
entries.content:
slew him with the sword. Compare Hebrews 11:37 .

common People. Hebrew sons of the people.

entries.title: Ahikam.
entries.content:
Ahikam. The father of Gedaliah, who, when appointed governor by Nebuchadnezzar, stood as the friend of Jeremiah. For a son of Ahikam also befriending Jeremiah, See Jeremiah 40:6 .

Shaphan. See note on 2 Kings 22:3 . See Jeremiah 36:10 for another son; Jeremiah 29:3 for another son. Also befriending Jeremiah.

entries.title: Jeremiah's Eighteenth Prophecy
entries.content:
Jeremiah's Eighteenth Prophecy (see book comments for Jeremiah).

Given in reign of Jehoiakim to Jeremiah. Declared, after thirteen years, in fourth year of Zedekiah: i.e. in 485. Compare Jeremiah 26:12 .Jeremiah 27 and Jeremiah 28 were written by Jeremiah, or at his dictation. Compare "me", Jeremiah 27:2 ; Jeremiah 28:1 . Some codices, with Syriac, read "Zedekiah", as in Jeremiah 26:3 and Jeremiah 26:12 .

In the beginning. The Massorah ( App-30 ) notes the fact that this expression occurs three times at the commencement of a verse (Genesis 1:1 .Genesis 26:1 ; Genesis 27:1 ).

came. At the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim; but it referred to a future time, as shown in Jeremiah 27:12 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

entries.title: put them, &c.
entries.content: put them, &c. This was literally done, as a prophetic symbol; and at that time prophetic of what was to happen in the reign of Zedekiah, eleven years later.

entries.title: and.
entries.content:
and. Note the Figure of speech Polysyndeton to emphasize each respectively.

which come = that are coming. Part. Poel, as in Genesis 37:19 ; Genesis 41:29 , Genesis 41:35 .Genesis 4:16 ; Genesis 6:22 ; Gen 7:32 ; Genesis 9:25 ; Genesis 16:14 ; Genesis 23:5 , Genesis 23:7 ; Genesis 31:27 , Genesis 31:31 , Genesis 31:38 ; Genesis 32:7 ; Jeremiah 33:5 , Jeremiah 33:14 , &c. This was to take place eleven years later.

unto Zedekiah. Then and there we have the fulfilment of this prophecy.

entries.title: the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel.
entries.content:
the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 7:3 .

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

entries.title: I have made, &c.
entries.content:
I have made, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Genesis 1:1 ). App-92 .

the ground. Hebrew the face of the ground. Figure of speech Pleonasm. App-6 . Some codices read "the face of all the ground".

ground = earth.

great power . . . outstretched arm. Reference to Pentateuch (Exodus 6:6 . Deuteronomy 4:34 ; Deuteronomy 5:15 ; Deuteronomy 7:19 ; Deuteronomy 9:29 ; Deuteronomy 11:2 ; Deuteronomy 26:8 ).

entries.title: Nebuchadnezzar.
entries.content:
Nebuchadnezzar. Some codices spell it "Nebuchadrezzar".

My servant. Compare Jeremiah 25:9 . See Daniel 2:37 , Daniel 2:38 .

entries.title: him, and his son, and his son's son:
entries.content:
him, and his son, and his son's son: i.e. Evil Merodach, Nergelissar, and Nabonidus, in whose seventeenth year Babylon was taken by Cyrus. App-67 .

the very time = the appointed end.

great kings: i.e. the kings of Persia and Media (Daniel 2:39 ).

entries.title: the same
entries.content:
the same = him.

saith the LORD = [is] Jehovah's oracle.

sword . . . famine . . . pestilence. Reference to Pentateuch (Leviticus 26:25 , Leviticus 26:26 . Deuteronomy 28:21-24 ). App-92 .

and. Note the Figure of speech Polysyndeton. App-6 .

entries.title: diviners, &c.
entries.content:
diviners, &c. These were their heathen guides.

enchanters = observers of the clouds.

sorcerers. These were mediums and necromancers.

entries.title: I spake:
entries.content:
I spake: i.e. thirteen years after this prophecy came to him. See note on Jeremiah 27:1 .

to Zedekiah. It is not stated whether he ever addressed the two other kings. Jehoahaz and Zedekiah were the sons of Hamutal; Jehoiakim was the son of the proud Zebudah (2 Kings 23:36 ). Compare Jeremiah 13:18 .

entries.title: Why . . . ?
entries.content:
Why . . . ? Figure of speech Asterismos.

by. Some codices, with Aramaean, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "and by", thus completing the Figure of speech Polysyndeton. Compare Jeremiah 27:8 .

as = according as.

entries.title: to the priests.
entries.content:
to the priests. Probably in the Temple. Compare Jeremiah 28:1 .

Behold. Figure of speech Asterismos.

the vessels: which were taken away by Nebuchadnezzar in the reigns of Jehoiakim and Jeconiah (2 Kings 24:13 . 2Ch 36:7 , 2 Chronicles 36:10 . Daniel 1:2 ).

entries.title: wherefore . . . ?
entries.content: wherefore . . . ? Figure of speech Erotesis. App-6 .

entries.title: Be
entries.content:
Be = exists; or, he and remain. Hebrew. yesh. Compare Jeremiah 31:6 , Jeremiah 31:16 , Jeremiah 31:17 , and see notes on Proverbs 8:21 ; Proverbs 18:24 .

the LORD of hosts = Jehovah Zebaoth. See note on Jer 6:6 . 1 Samuel 1:3 .

at. Some codices, with three early printed editions, omit this "at".

entries.title: remain.
entries.content:
remain. Probably because they were too heavy and cumbrous.

city. So the reading of Ben-Asher; but Ben-Naphtali reads "land". These were the two rival critics of the Hebrew text in the tenth century A.D. who furnished the vowel-points. Ben-Asher's work was done at Tiberias in 827 "from the destruction of Jerusalem", and is now at Aleppo. Of Ben- Naphtali nothing is known beyond official lists which have come down to us.

entries.title: Jeconiah.
entries.content: Jeconiah. Compare Jeremiah 24:1 .

entries.title: in.
entries.content: in. Some codices, with three early printed editions, read this "in" in the text.

entries.title: then will I bring them up.
entries.content: then will I bring them up. Fulfilled by Cyrus (Ezra 1:7 ; Ezra 5:13 , Ezra 5:14 ).

entries.title: the same year.
entries.content:
the same year. As Jeremiah 27:12 , when Jeremiah spoke to Zedekiah; not Jeremiah 27:1 , when he received the message which was to be delivered. The same year in which Jeremiah had counseled Zedekiah not to hearken to the false prophets (Jeremiah 27:14 ).

Hananiah. A false prophet. Compare Jeremiah 27:12 , Jeremiah 27:14 .

Gibeon. A city of the priests (Joshua 21:17 ). Hananiah was therefore probably a priest as Jeremiah was.

in the house. Compare Jeremiah 26:2 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah.

entries.title: the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel.
entries.content:
the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 7:3 .

I have broken. This was proved to be a false promise.

entries.title: two full years.
entries.content:
two full years. Hebrew two years in days [measured in] days: i.e. complete years. Compare Genesis 41:1 . a Samaritan Pentateuch Jeremiah 13:23 . Not years of days (a day for a year).

Nebuchadnezzar. See note on Jeremiah 27:6 .

entries.title: captives.
entries.content:
captives. Hebrew captivity. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Subject), for the people in captivity.

saith the LORD = [is] Jehovah's oracle.

entries.title: Jeremiah.
entries.content: Jeremiah. Spelled here, and in this chapter only (except Jeremiah 27:1 .Ezra 1:1 .Daniel 9:2; Daniel 9:2 ), in an abbreviated form, " Yirmeyah" instead of " Yirmeyahu ", as elsewhere. This may be to bring the true prophet into stronger contrast with the false " Hananeyah".

entries.title: Amen.
entries.content:
Amen. Interpreted in the words which follow.

words. Some codices, with three early printed editions, Aramaean, and Septuagint, read "word" (singular)

entries.title: evil
entries.content: evil = calamity. Hebrew. ra'a'. Some codices, with one early printed edition, read "famine". Compare Jeremiah 27:8 , and Jeremiah 29:17 .

entries.title: shall come to pass.
entries.content: shall come to pass. Accusative case to the test laid down in Deuteronomy 18:21 , Deuteronomy 18:22 (reference to Pentateuch) App-92 .

entries.title: the yoke.
entries.content:
the yoke. See Jeremiah 27:2 . Made of wood (Jeremiah 28:13 ).

from off. So that Jeremiah was still wearing it (Jeremiah 27:2 ).

entries.title: went his way.
entries.content: went his way. Having no further word from Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah's Nineteenth Prophecy
entries.content:
Jeremiah's Nineteenth Prophecy (see book comments for Jeremiah).

Then = And. Evidently shortly after this.

entries.title: for
entries.content:
for = instead of.

yokes of iron. These are never used. No stronger symbol could have been given.

entries.title: I have put, &c.
entries.content: I have put, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 28:48 , the same words).

entries.title: not sent thee.
entries.content:
not sent thee. The test applied (Deuteronomy 18:21 , Deuteronomy 18:22 ).

trust = confide.

entries.title: the earth
entries.content:
the earth = the ground, or soil.

die. According to Deuteronomy 18:20 . Reference to Pentateuch

taught = spoken. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 13:5 ). App-92 .

rebellion, &c. Zedekiah had taken an oath of allegiance to Nebuchadnezzar (2 Kings 24:17 . 2 Chronicles 36:13 .Ezekiel 17:15 , Ezekiel 17:18 ). So it was a double rebellion.

entries.title: seventh month:
entries.content: seventh month: i.e. two months after, instead of "two years" (Jeremiah 28:3 ).

entries.title: words:
entries.content:
words: i.e. prophecies, as in Jeremiah 25:1 ; Jeremiah 26:1 ; Jeremiah 27:1 ; Jeremiah 30:1 , &c.

letter = writing.

residue of the elders. Compare Ezekiel 8:1 ; Ezekiel 14:1 ; Ezekiel 20:1 .

the prophets: i.e. Ezekiel (Jeremiah 1:1 ); Daniel (Jeremiah 1:6 ).

Nebuchadnezzar. Same spelling as throughout Jeremiah 2 8 and Jeremiah 29:3 here. Not the same as in Jeremiah 29:21 .

entries.title: Jeconiah:
entries.content:
Jeconiah: i.e. Jehoiachin.

the queen = the queen-mother, Nehushta, the wife of Jehoiakim. Compare Jeremiah 13:18 . See 2 Kings 24:12 , 2 Kings 24:15 .

eunuchs = chamberlains.

carpenters = artificers, smiths. Compare Jeremiah 24:1 .

entries.title: Shaphan.
entries.content:
Shaphan. See note on 2 Kings 22:3 .

Zedekiah . . . sent. Compare Jeremiah 51:59 .

entries.title: seek the peace
entries.content:
seek the peace = seek the welfare. Compare Ezra 6:10 .

captives. For sixty-three years. From Jehoiachin's captivity to Cyrus (489-426 = 63).

entries.title: seventy years.
entries.content: seventy years. See special note on 2 Chronicles 36:21 .

entries.title: an expected end.
entries.content: an expected end. Figure of speech Hendiadys. Hebrew "an end and an expectation" = an end, yea, an end which I have caused you to hope for: i.e. a hoped-for end.

entries.title: ye shall seek Me.
entries.content: ye shall seek Me. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 4:29 ; Deuteronomy 30:2 ).

entries.title: away
entries.content:
away = back.

captivity. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Subject), for captives.

entries.title: of
entries.content: of = concerning.

entries.title: I will send . . . the sword, &c.
entries.content:
I will send . . . the sword, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Leviticus 26:25 , Leviticus 26:26 ).

the famine. Some codices, with three early printed editions (one in margin), Aramaean, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "and famine", thus completing the Figure of speech Polysyndeton .

vile figs = worthless figs. See Jeremiah 24:2 .

entries.title: with.
entries.content:
with. Some codices, with one early printed edition, read "and with".

removed. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 28:25 , the same word).

entries.title: unto them.
entries.content:
unto them. Some codices, with four early printed editions, read "unto you".

rising up early, &c . See note on Jeremiah 7:13 .

entries.title: sent.
entries.content: sent. Some codices, with Aramaean, read "caused to be carried captive". Compare Jeremiah 24:5 .

entries.title: Ahab . . . Zedekiah.
entries.content:
Ahab . . . Zedekiah. These were false prophets-whom Nebuchadrezzar treated as stated in Jeremiah 29:22 .

Kolaiah . . . curse . . . roasted. Note the Figure of speech Paronomasia . Hebrew. Kolayah . . . kelah . . . kalam.

Nebuchadrezzar. Some codices read Nebuchadnezzar.

entries.title: a curse
entries.content: a curse = a curse formula.

entries.title: committed villany
entries.content: committed villany = vileness: i.e. worshipped idols. See the first occurance Genesis 34:7 .

entries.title: Nehelamite:
entries.content: Nehelamite: or, dreamer.

entries.title: mad.
entries.content:
mad. Compare John 2:20 ; John 10:20 , John 10:39 . See App-85 .

maketh himself a prophet. Compare Matthew 21:11 . Joh 8:53 . See App-85 .

entries.title: trust
entries.content: trust = confide. Hebrew. batah. App-69 .

entries.title: rebellion, &c.
entries.content: rebellion, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 13:5 ). App-92 .

entries.title: Jeremiah's Twentieth Prophecy
entries.content:
Jeremiah's Twentieth Prophecy (see book comments for Jeremiah).

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

entries.title: the LORD God of Israel.
entries.content:
the LORD God of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 11:3 .

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

in a book. For abiding comfort and hope in the coming times of trouble. Written before the deportation. Compare Jeremiah 30:5-11 , Jeremiah 30:12-24 . A dark foreground is shown in Jeremiah 31:37 .

entries.title: lo.
entries.content:
lo. Figure of speech Asterismos. App-6 .

Israel. As well as Judah.

entries.title: these are the words.
entries.content: these are the words. This is the introduction to the two chapters.

entries.title: a man
entries.content:
a man = a male. Hebrew. zakar.

man = a strong man. Hebrew. geber . App-14 .

entries.title: that day.
entries.content:
that day. The interpretation here is of the day of Babylon's overthrow. The application is of the yet future Great Tribulation of Matthew 24 . This is in contrast with the day of Restoration.

great, &c. = too great to have another like it.

Jacob's. Not Israel's, for it is the natural seed that is here in question, not the spiritual. See notes on Genesis 32:28 ; Genesis 43:6 ; Genesis 45:26 , Genesis 45:28 .

entries.title: break his yoke.
entries.content: break his yoke. Reminding us of Jeremiah 28:10 , Jeremiah 28:11 .

entries.title: David their king.
entries.content: David their king. This is yet future. Compare Ezekiel, Jeremiah's contemporary (Ezekiel 34:23 , Ezekiel 34:24 ; Ezekiel 37:24 , Ezekiel 37:25 .Isaiah 55:3 .Hosea 3:5; Hosea 3:5 ) for seven years (484-477). See App-77 .

entries.title: fear thou not, &c.
entries.content:
fear thou not, &c. Taking up Isaiah 41:10 , Isaiah 41:18 ; Isaiah 43:5 ; Isaiah 44:2 .

shall be in rest = be [again] in rest.

entries.title: in measure
entries.content:
in measure = to the due measure.

unpunished = guiltless. Reference to Pentateuch (Exodus 20:7 ; Exodus 34:7 . Numbers 14:18 ). App-92 .

entries.title: that thou mayest, &c.
entries.content: that thou mayest, &c. = for binding thee up.

entries.title: all they that devour thee, &c.
entries.content: all they that devour thee, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Exodus 23:22 ).

entries.title: upon her own heap.
entries.content:
upon her own heap. This cannot have a spiritual application; still less interpretation. It is literally Zion. This was written in the book, before the siege, which had already been foretold (chs. 7; 19; Jeremiah 21:10 , Jeremiah 34:2 , Jeremiah 37:10 ).

heap = ruins.

palace = fortress.

after the manner thereof: or, upon its own site.

entries.title: them:
entries.content:
them: i.e. the restored cities and palaces.

I will multiply . Note the Alternation : | multiply. | not be few. | glorify. | not be despised.

small = small (in number).

entries.title: children
entries.content:
children = sons.

oppress. First used by God Himself (Exodus 3:9 ).

entries.title: their nobles.
entries.content:
their nobles. Hebrew his Prince.

their governor. Hebrew his Ruler.

cause him to draw near. Reference to Pentateuch (Numbers 16:5 ).

who is this . . . ? Compare Isaiah 63:1 (in judgment). Matthew 21:10 (in grace).

engaged = pledged.

entries.title: continuing whirlwind
entries.content:
continuing whirlwind = a tempest rolling itself upward: i.e. a roaring tempest.

the wicked = lawless ones (plural) Hebrew. rasha'. App-44 .

entries.title: the latter days
entries.content: the latter days = the end of the days. Reference to Pentateuch (Genesis 49:1 ). Compare Jeremiah 23:20 . App-92 . consider = understand. Compare Jeremiah 23:20 .

entries.title: At the same time:
entries.content:
At the same time: i.e. in the latter days (Jeremiah 30:24 ).

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

of = to.

all. Not Judah alone.

they shall be My People. Reference to Pentateuch (Leviticus 26:12 ). App-92 . Compare Jeremiah 30:22 .

entries.title: when I went.
entries.content: when I went. Reference to Pentateuch (Exodus 3 .Numbers 10:33 .Deuteronomy 1:33; Deuteronomy 1:33 ). App-92 .

entries.title: everlasting love.
entries.content: everlasting love. See notes on Isaiah 44:7 .

entries.title: Again . . . again, &c.
entries.content:
Again . . . again, &c. App-92 . Figure of speech Anaphora .

tabrets. See notes on Exodus 15:20 . 1 Samuel 10:5 .

entries.title: vines
entries.content:
vines = vineyards.

mountains. A special reading called Sevir ( App-34 ), reads "cities".

eat them as common things. Reference to Pentateuch (Leviticus 19:23-25 .Deuteronomy 20:6 ; Deuteronomy 28:30 ). Compare Isaiah 62:9 . App-92 .

entries.title: there shall be
entries.content:
there shall be = there is. Hebrew. yesh. See note on Proverbs 8:21 , and Proverbs 18:24 .

mount = hill country.

entries.title: Jacob.
entries.content:
Jacob. Note the frequent use of "Jacob" in these chapters, referring to the natural seed.

save Thy People. Compare the Hebrew Hosannah. See Psalms 118:25 , and see note on Matthew 21:9 .

entries.title: Behold.
entries.content:
Behold. Figure of speech Asterismos.

gather = gather out.

coasts = borders, or extremities.

company = an organized community.

thither = hither.

entries.title: rivers
entries.content:
rivers = streams. Hebrew nahal = a wady.

Ephraim is My firstborn. Reference to Pentateuch (Exodus 4:22 ). App-92 . "My firstborn" occurs nowhere else. Compare Psalms 89:27 . Ephraim is put by Figure of speech Synecdoche (of the Part), for all the ten tribes.

entries.title: isles
entries.content:
isles = coastlands, or maritime countries.

He that scattered, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 30:3 ).

entries.title: redeemed
entries.content:
redeemed = liberated, or redeemed (by power). Hebrew. padah. See note on Exodus 13:13 .

ransomed = redeemed (by blood) and avenged. Hebrew. ga'al. See note on Exodus 6:6 .

stronger. See note on Psalms 35:10 .

entries.title: flow together.
entries.content:
flow together. Same word as in Jeremiah 51:44 .Isaiah 2:2 .Micah 4:1 .

wine. Hebrew. tirosh. App-27 .

soul. Hebrew. nephesh.

entries.title: A voice was heard, &c.
entries.content:
A voice was heard, &c. Quoted in Matthew 2:18 . Reference to Pentateuch (Genesis 35:19 ). App-92 .

in Ramah = on the high place. Evidently a "high place" near Bethlehem. A common name in Palestine. The Targum and Vulg, read "in a high place".

Rahel = Rachel. The mother of Joseph and Benjamin (i.e. Ephraim); thus uniting the two kingdoms and the two peoples. Compare Jeremiah 31:9 .

children = sons.

because they were not. Now, another weeping, and other comfort given. Compare verses: Jeremiah 31:9 , Jeremiah 31:16 . Reference to Pentateuch (Genesis 42:36 ). App-92 .

entries.title: shall be rewarded
entries.content:
shall be rewarded = there exists a reward. Hebrew. yesh. See note on Jeremiah 31:6 .

come again: i.e. in resurrection. Compare Jeremiah 31:15 .

entries.title: there is
entries.content: there is = there exists. Hebrew. yesh . Compare Jeremiah 31:6 .

entries.title: I have surely heard, &c.
entries.content:
I have surely heard, &c. Figure of speech Prolepsis.

hast chastised = didst chastise.

was chastised = I have been chastised.

turn Thou me = cause Thou me to return.

entries.title: child
entries.content:
child = a young child. Hebrew. yalad.

My bowels are troubled. Figure of speech Anthropopatheia. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 32:36 ). Compare Duke Jeremiah 15:20 .

entries.title: Set thee up
entries.content:
Set thee up = Erect.

make thee = set up.

high heaps: i.e. finger posts.

entries.title: go about:
entries.content:
go about: i.e. in order to elude by withdrawing. Elsewhere only in Song of Solomon 5:6 .

new thing. The interpretation must satisfy this condition.

in the earth = in the land. This is another condition.

A woman = A spouse: i.e. Israel shall turn and cleave to the Mighty One. See Genesis 1:27 ; Genesis 5:2 ; Genesis 6:19 ; Genesis 7:3 , Genesis 7:9 , Genesis 7:16 . Leviticus 3:1 , Leviticus 3:6 ; Leviticus 4:28 ; Leviticus 5:6 , &c. Here, the virgin of Israel.

compass = turn about [so as to return to and seek the favour of] the man. A "new thing"for a woman to become the suitor. See Jeremiah 31:14 and Deuteronomy 24:4 .Hosea 2:19 , &c. Hebrew. sabab, to turn about, used in Psalms 26:6 , "so will I compass Thine altar", not go round it, but keep close to it. Compare Psalms 7:7 . (Jonah 2:5 , "closed me round"). bring again. This cannot be spiritualized.

man. Hebrew. 'adam. App-14 .

watched. Compare Jeremiah 1:12 (same word).

and. Note the Figure of speech Polysyndeton ( App-6 ).

and will be their God. Compare Jeremiah 24:7 ; Jeremiah 30:22 ; Jeremiah 32:38 .

they shall all know Me. See note on Jeremiah 9:24 .

ordinances = statutes. Reference to Pentateuch (Genesis 8:22 ). Compare Jeremiah 33:20 , Jeremiah 33:25 .

divideth = -stirreth up, or exciteth.

the seed. Note the Structure (on p. 1061).

for ever = all the days.

holy. See note on Exodus 3:6 .

entries.content: had shut him up. One of the eleven rulers who were offended with God's messengers. See note on Exodus 10:28 .

entries.title: his eyes shall behold his eyes:
entries.content: his eyes shall behold his eyes: he should go to Babylon (Jeremiah 34:3 ). Yet Ezekiel (Jeremiah 12:13 ) declared that he should not "see" Babylon. Both statements were true; for we read that Zedekiah did "see" the king of Babylon at Riblah, but his eyes being put out there (2 Kings 25:6 , 2 Kings 25:7 ), he never saw Babylon, though he was led there. See Jeremiah 52:10 , Jeremiah 52:11 .

subscribed. Some codices, with three early printed editions, Aramaean, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "[whose names] were written".

before. Some codices, with Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "and before".

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

nothing too hard for Thee. Reference to Pentateuch (Genesis 18:14 ). App-92 .

iniquity. Hebrew. 'avah. App-44 .

after them. Compare Exodus 34:6 , Exodus 34:7 .

the LORD of Hosts. See note on Jeremiah 6:6 .

men. Hebrew. 'adam. App-14 .

signs and wonders. App-92 . Elsewhere only in Psalms 78:43 ; Psalms 105:27 ; Psalms 135:9 ; and Nehemiah 9:10 .

other men = mankind. Hebrew. 'adam. App-14 .

made Thee a name. Reference to Pentateuch (Exodus 9:16 ).

law. Hebrew text has "laws" in margin, with some codices and three early printed editions.

evil. Hebrew. ra'a'. App-44 .

plant. Compare Jeremiah 1:10 .

house. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Adjunct), for the descendants of Rechab, through Jonadab his son. who became their chieftain and lawgiver. Compare Jeremiah 35:6 .

wine. Hebrew. yayin. [fermented wine] App-27 .

Igdaliah. See note on Psalms 90:1 .

evil. Hebrew. ra'a'. App-44 .

entries.content: shut up. Not in prison (for Compare Jeremiah 36:19 ), but in hiding, or from some unexplained reason.

entries.title: the fasting day
entries.content: the fasting day = a fast day. Being in the ninth month (Jeremiah 36:9 ), it was not that prescribed in the Law, which was in the seventh month (Leviticus 16:29 ; Leviticus 23:27 ).

entries.title: the fifth year.
entries.content:
the fifth year. The reading was deferred for some months.

ninth month. Our December. See App-51 .

they proclaimed, &c. = all the People of Jerusalem, and all the People who were coming in and out of the cities of Jerusalem, had proclaimed a fast before Jehovah.

entries.title: Gemariah.
entries.content:
Gemariah. He was brother of Ahikam (Jeremiah 26:24 ), and not the Gemariah of Jeremiah 29:3 , who was Hilkiah's son.

Shaphan. See note on 2 Kings 22:3 .

the scribe: i.e. Shaphan (not Gemariah), who was the scribe in Josiah's days. See 2 Kings 22:3 , 2 Kings 22:8 , 2Ki 22:9 , 2 Kings 22:10 , 2 Kings 22:12 . At the time of this history Elishama was the scribe (unless there were more than one). See verses: Jeremiah 36:12 , Jeremiah 36:20 , Jeremiah 36:21 .

entries.title: of
entries.content: of = from.

entries.title: went down.
entries.content:
went down. Compare Jeremiah 22:1 .

Elnathan. The king's emissary against Urijah (Jeremiah 26:22 ).

entries.title: the
entries.content: the = in the.

entries.title: Sit down now.
entries.content: Sit down now. Compare "stood" (Jeremiah 36:21 ). Showing that these princes were favourable to Jeremiah.

entries.title: the words.
entries.content:
the words. Some codices, with two early printed editions, read "these words".

We will surely tell. Showing their earnestness and sincerity in the matter.

entries.title: man.
entries.content: man. Hebrew. 'ish. App-14 .

entries.title: Stood.
entries.content: Stood. See note on Jeremiah 36:15 .

entries.title: on the hearth
entries.content: on the hearth = in the brasier: i.e. the vessel into which the burning charcoal was put from the hearth in houses of the better sort.

entries.title: leaves
entries.content:
leaves = columns.

he: i.e. the king.

cut it = cut it up into fragments.

penknife = a scribe ' s knife. The words of Jehovah are cut up to-day, not with a scribe's knife, but with scribe's pens in the hands of the modern critics. Yet they are "not afraid".

entries.title: not afraid.
entries.content: not afraid. The courtiers were less open to holy fear than the People were. See note on Jeremiah 36:9 . Contrast Jehoiakim's father, king Josiah (2 Kings 22:11 ). Contrast also the sentence pronounced on them (2 Kings 22:18-20 with Jeremiah 36:30 , below on "him").

entries.title: Nevertheless
entries.content:
Nevertheless = Moreover.

made intercession. Showing that Elnathan was less hostile than we might perhaps have concluded from Jeremiah 26:22 and 2 Kings 24:8 .

entries.title: Hammelech
entries.content: Hammelech = the king. Compare Jeremiah 38:6 . 1Ki 22:26 . 2 Kings 11:1 , 2 Kings 11:2 .Zephaniah 1:8 .

entries.title: The Thirty-Third Prophecy of Jeremiah
entries.content:
The Thirty-Third Prophecy of Jeremiah (see book comments for Jeremiah).

came. The word of the LORD was "not bound". Compare 2 Timothy 2:9 .

the roll, and the words. Note the Figure of speech Hendiadys = "the roll, yea, the very words of Jehovah written therein".

entries.title: another roll.
entries.content: another roll. See the Structure, (p. 1069). We are not told what became of this, so it may have got, later, into the hands of Nehemiah, when he visited the Temple ruins.

entries.title: thou shalt say.
entries.content: thou shalt say. Not verbally to Jehoiakim, but in the other scroll.

entries.title: of
entries.content:
of = concerning.

none to sit, &c. = none sitting, &c. Hebrew. yashab, implying permanence. His son Jehoiachin reigned only three months, and then only on sufferance (2 Kings 24:6-8 ). See note on Jeremiah 22:30 . See App-99 .

entries.title: punish him
entries.content: punish him = visit upon him. Reference to Pentateuch (Exodus 32:34 ). App-92 .

entries.title: like words
entries.content: like words = like unto them. They are preserved to us in this book to a large extent. The history in Jeremiah 37 and Jeremiah 38 reverts to the last two years of Zedekiah's reign, and the actual siege of Jerusalem. It is a new and independent section. See Structure, above.

entries.title: Coniah:
entries.content: Coniah: i.e. Jeconiah, called also Jehoiachin. whom: i.e. Zedekiah.

entries.title: words
entries.content: words = prophecies.

entries.title: Pharaoh's:
entries.content: Pharaoh's: i.e. Pharaoh Hophra's. Compare Jeremiah 44:30 . The Apries of Herodotus, and fourth successor of Psammeticus on the throne of Egypt. He came to help Zedekiah (Ezekiel 17:15-17 ), but was defeated by the Chaldeans, and Egypt subdued. Compare 2 Kings 24:7 . Ezekiel 29:1-16 and chs. 30-33. Also Jeremiah 43:9-13 .

entries.title: The Thirty-Fourth Prophecy of Jeremiah
entries.content:
The Thirty-Fourth Prophecy of Jeremiah (see book comments for Jeremiah).

the LORD, the God of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 11:3 .

Behold. Figure of speech Asterismos.

entries.title: yourselves
entries.content: yourselves = your own souls. Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 .

entries.title: every man.
entries.content: every man. Hebrew. 'ish. App-14 .

entries.title: to go, &c.
entries.content:
to go, &c. Probably to Anathoth.

to separate himself thence = to assign [himself] his portion there (i.e. at Anathoth, in Benjamin, three and a half miles north-east of Jerusalem), where he drew his living.

in the midst: for safety, and to avoid detection.

entries.title: the gate of Benjamin:
entries.content:
the gate of Benjamin: i.e. the northern gate, called also "the gate of Ephraim" (2 Kings 14:13 .Nehemiah 8:16; Nehemiah 8:16 ), leading to Anathoth.

Hananiah. Perhaps the false prophet mentioned in Jeremiah 28:1-17 .

entries.title: princes.
entries.content: princes. Named in Jeremiah 38:1 ; none of whom had been favourable to Jeremiah in the days of Jehoiakim (Jeremiah 26:16 ).

entries.title: smote
entries.content:
smote = scourged.

put him in prison. Note Jeremiah ' s prison experiences:. (1) put in on false charge (Jeremiah 37:11-15 ); (2) released, but confined in the court of the prison; (3) imprisoned again in Malchiah's miry dungeon (Jeremiah 38:1-6 ); (4) released again as before (Jeremiah 38:13-28 ); (5) carried away in chains by Nebuchadnezzar, but released at Ramah (Jeremiah 40:1-4 ).

in prison = in the house of bonds.

the prison = the house of detention.

entries.title: When, &c.
entries.content:
When, &c. = For Jeremiah [actually] entered, &c,

dungeon = house of the pit. Hebrew. bor. See notes on Genesis 21:19 ("well"). Isaiah 14:19 ("pit").

cabins = cells.

remained = abode. Note the Figure of speech Cyeloides , marking the refrain, which is repeated in Jeremiah 37:21 , and in Jeremiah 38:13 , Jeremiah 38:28 ; as shown in the Structure.

entries.title: Is there . . . There is =
entries.content: Is there . . . There is = Does there exist. . . ? . . . There does exist. Hebrew. yesh . . . yesh . See notes on Proverbs 8:21 ; Proverbs 18:24 ; and Luke 7:25 .

entries.title: offended
entries.content:
offended = sinned.

prison = the house of detention. See Jeremiah 37:16 .

entries.title: your prophets.
entries.content: your prophets. Not Jehovah's. From the beginning they had prophesied falsely. See Jeremiah 6:14 ; Jeremiah 27:16 ; Jeremiah 28:2 .

entries.title: prison
entries.content:
prison = guard-house. Not the same word as in Jeremiah 37:15 .

piece = a cake. Compare Jeremiah 52:6 . Three were reckoned as a meal (Luke 11:5 ); a soldier's ration at that time.

entries.title: Pashur.
entries.content: Pashur. See note on Jeremiah 20:1 .

entries.title: goeth forth.
entries.content:
goeth forth. Some codices add "and falleth".

life = soul.

entries.title: welfare
entries.content: welfare = peace.

entries.title: dungeon.
entries.content:
dungeon. See note on Jeremiah 37:16 .

Hammelech = the king. See note on Jeremiah 36:26 .

prison = house of detention.

sunk in the mire. To be preferred to the moral sinking of Zedekiah in Jeremiah 38:22 .

entries.title: Ebed-meleoh the Ethiopian.
entries.content: Ebed-meleoh the Ethiopian. See Jeremiah 39:16 ; and compare Acts 8:27-38 .

entries.title: Ebed-melech.
entries.content: Ebed-melech. Some codices add "the Ethiopian".

entries.title: thirty.
entries.content: thirty. The king knew the danger. No need to suppose that "thirty" is a copyist's error for "three"!

entries.title: old cast
entries.content:
old cast = cast-off clothes.

clouts = patches. Ang. -Sax. clut = a patch.

entries.title: armholes
entries.content: armholes = armpits.

entries.title: remained.
entries.content: remained. See note on Jeremiah 37:18 .

entries.title: Then, &c.
entries.content: Then, &c. This is the last picture of Zedekiah, and the house of Judah.

entries.title: wilt thou not . . . me?
entries.content: wilt thou not . . . me? = thou wilt not. This second clause is not a question in the Hebrew text.

entries.title: As the LORD liveth
entries.content:
As the LORD liveth = By the life of Jehovah.

soul. Hebrew. nephesh ( App-13 ): i.e. May He Who gave us both our life, take mine away if I take thine, or give thee, &c.

entries.title: the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel.
entries.content:
the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 35:17 .

the God of hosts. Some codices, with Aramaean, Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, omit "God", and read "Jehovah Z baioth, God of Israel".

entries.title: afraid
entries.content: afraid = apprehensive.

entries.title: princes.
entries.content:
princes. Showing that Nebuchadnezzar himself was not there. Compare Jeremiah 39:1 .

set thee on = persuaded thee. See note on Jeremiah 20:7 .

sunk in the mire. The moral sinking of Zedekiah far worse than Jeremiah's physical sinking.

entries.title: children
entries.content:
children = sons.

thou shalt cause this city to be burned. Hebrew thou wilt burn. Note the idiom by which the act is put for the declaration that it should be done.

entries.title: he told them, &c.
entries.content:
he told them, &c. In Holy Scripture we have an inspired record of what was said and done by others, but it does not follow that all that was so said and done was inspired.

commanded. Some codices, with Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, add "him".

entries.title: abode.
entries.content: abode. See the note on Jeremiah 37:16 . further date: viz. "in the tenth day of the month".

entries.title: broken up.
entries.content: broken up. Compare Ch. Jeremiah 52:6 ; which explains that provisions had failed before then.

entries.title: Sarsechim.
entries.content:
Sarsechim. Some codices, with four early printed editions, read "Sar-sechim". It is the plural of the Akkadian Sar-sak = king ' s son. R

ab-saris = chief of the chamberlains. Compare 2 Kings 18:17 . Daniel 1:3 , Daniel 1:7 .

Nergal-sharezer, Rab-mag = Nergal-sharezer, chief of the physicians (or magi). Only four names of persons in this verse, not six.

entries.title: the plain.
entries.content: the plain. To avoid the Jordan.

entries.title: Jericho.
entries.content:
Jericho. Thus, Jericho was the scene of Israel's first victory (Joshua 6 ), and final defeat.

Riblah. Now Hibleh, on the east bank of the Greekntes, thirty-five miles north-east of Baalbek, the base and headquarters of Nebuchadnezzar. Some twenty-two years before, Jehoahaz was put in bonds here by Pharaoh-nechoh, to be led captive to Egypt. See 2 Kings 23:33 .

gave judgment = pronounced sentence: i.e. for his perjury. See 2 Chronicles 36:10 , 2 Chronicles 36:13 .Ezekiel 17:15 , Ezekiel 17:18 .

entries.title: before his eyes.
entries.content: before his eyes. A specimen of the inhumanity of those days.

entries.title: put out Zedekiah's eyes.
entries.content:
put out Zedekiah's eyes. So that Ezekiel was quite correct when he said that Zedekiah should be taken to Babylon, though he should not see it (Ezekiel 12:13 ).

with chains = with two fetters.

to carry him. Ch. Jeremiah 52:11 , and 2 Kings 25:7 , show that this purpose was executed. It was not so with Jehoiakim (2 Chronicles 36:6 ).

entries.title: the Chaldeans burned, &c.
entries.content: the Chaldeans burned, &c. On the tenth day of the fifth month. Compare Jeremiah 52:12 , Jeremiah 52:13 . The same day as the capture of the city by the Romans in A.D. 69.

entries.title: Nebuzar-adan
entries.content:
Nebuzar-adan = the prince favoured by Nebo.

the guard = the executioners (2 Kings 25:8 ). Compare Genesis 37:36 ; Genesis 39:1 .

entries.title: poor.
entries.content: poor. Hebrew. dal. See note on "poverty", Proverbs 6:11 .

entries.title: to
entries.content: to = to the hand of, or through.

entries.title: look well to him.
entries.content: look well to him. Not the first, rejected by the Jews, who was honoured by the Gentiles.

entries.title: prison
entries.content:
prison = house of detention: as in Jeremiah 38:6 , Jeremiah 38:13 , Jeremiah 38:28 .

Gedaliah. See note on Ahikam, Jeremiah 26:24 . Compare Jeremiah 40:6 .

Shaphan. See note on 2 Kings 22:3 .

carry him home. Some codices, with one early printed edition (Rabbinic), read "out of the [prison] house". From the next chapter we learn that he was taken north to Ramah with other captives, and from that place was set free, and went to Gedaliah to Mizpah (Jeremiah 40:6 ). This verse (Jeremiah 39:14 ) is only a brief summary.

so = and.

entries.title: The Thirty-Fifth Prophecy of Jeremiah
entries.content:
The Thirty-Fifth Prophecy of Jeremiah (see book comments for Jeremiah).

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

entries.title: Go and speak.
entries.content:
Go and speak. Not to interrupt the history, this incident as to Ebed-melech is reserved till now.

the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 7:3 .

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

Behold. Figure of speech Asterismos.

evil = calamity. Hebrew. ra'a'. App-44 .

entries.title: saith the LORD
entries.content: saith the LORD = [is] Jehovah's oracle.

entries.title: life
entries.content:
life = soul. Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 .

a prey: i.e. he should save it. Compare Jeremiah 21:9 .

put thy trust = confided. Hebrew. batah. App-69 .

entries.title: The Thirty-Sixth Prophecy of Jeremiah
entries.content:
The Thirty-Sixth Prophecy of Jeremiah (see book comments for Jeremiah).

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

chains = the two fetters, as in Jeremiah 39:7 .

entries.title: the guard.
entries.content:
the guard. See note on Jeremiah 39:9 .

said. Nebuzar-adan takes all the credit to himself. Compare Jeremiah 39:11 .

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

evil = calamity. Hebrew. ra'a. App-44 .

entries.title: because ye have sinned, &c.
entries.content: because ye have sinned, &c. Reference to Pentateuch.

entries.title: behold.
entries.content:
behold. Figure of speech Asterism o s . App-6 .

hand. Some codices, with eight early printed editions, Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "hands".

entries.title: Now while he was not yet gone back
entries.content:
Now while he was not yet gone back = And ere yet he could make reply.

Gedaliah. See note on Jeremiah 26:24 , and Compare Jeremiah 39:14 .

Shaphan. See note on 2 Kings 22:3 .

reward = present.

entries.title: Mizpah.
entries.content: Mizpah. North of Jerusalem, near Anathoth. Compare Jeremiah 41:5-9 . Joshua 18:26 . 1Sa 7:16 ; 1 Samuel 10:17 , and 1 Kings 15:22 . The scene of the following events: here had been Asa's fortress (Jeremiah 41:9 ); here Sennacherib and Nebuchadnezzar and Titus got their first view of Jerusalem.

entries.title: men.
entries.content:
men. Hebrew pi. of 'enosh. App-14 .

governor. No more attempts to make a king, after Zedekiah's perjury. See Ezekiel 17:15-19 .

children = young children.

poor. Hebrew "poverty", put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Adjunct), App-6 , for poor people. See Proverbs 6:11 .

entries.title: Ishmael.
entries.content:
Ishmael. The Massorites ( App-30 ) set their hand to obliterate the Divine names in the case of men who had served to disgrace it. One is ' el , in the compound "Ishmael", which means "whom my El heareth". It is used of five different men, and occurs forty-eight times: twenty times of Hagar's son; twenty-three times of Nethaniah's son in this history; and five times of the other three. On account of his horrible treachery, the memory of which is perpetuated by the fast of the seventh month (Zechariah 7:5 ; Zechariah 8:9 ), the vowel points were changed to obliterate the Divine Name (El): viz. yishma'el, instead of yishma'el, which is not observable in the ordinary English spelling.

sons. Some codices, with Aram, and Septuagint, read "son", as in Jeremiah 40:13 .

Netophathite = a man of Netophah, now Khan Umm Tobah, north of Bethlehem (1 Chronicles 2:54 .Ezra 2:22 .Nehemiah 7:26; Nehemiah 7:26 ).

entries.title: wine.
entries.content:
wine. Hebrew. yayin. App-27 .

summer fruits. Hebrew "summer". Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Adjunct), App-6 , for the fruits gathered in summer.

entries.title: fields
entries.content: fields = field (singular)

entries.title: slay thee
entries.content: slay thee = strike thy soul. Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 .

entries.title: man.
entries.content:
man. Hebrew ' Ish . App-14 .

gathered = gathered out.

entries.title: Elishama.
entries.content:
Elishama. A seal has been found with his name on it.

even = and.

Gedaliah. See note on Jeremiah 26:24 ; and Compare Jeremiah 39:14 , and Jeremiah 40:5 .

Mizpah. See note on Jeremiah 40:6 .

entries.title: Ishmael.
entries.content:
Ishmael. See note on Jeremiah 40:8 .

had made. Compare Jeremiah 40:5 .

entries.title: and.
entries.content: and. Some codices, with Vulg, and three early printed editions, read this "and" in the text.

entries.title: Shiloh.
entries.content:
Shiloh. The last of five references to Shiloh in Jeremiah. Compare Jeremiah 7:12 , Jeremiah 7:14 ; Jeremiah 26:6 , Jeremiah 26:9 .

offerings. These would be meal-offerings, according to Leviticus 2:1 . Flesh sacrifices were now impossible. Reference to Pentateuch (Leviticus 2:1 ). Probably for the feast of the fifteenth (Leviticus 23:23 , Leviticus 23:34 .Numbers 29:12 .Deuteronomy 16:13; Deuteronomy 16:13 ).

to the house, &c. Still recognised as the place which Jehovah had chosen.

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

entries.title: weeping all along as he went
entries.content: weeping all along as he went = going on and on weeping.

entries.title: treasures
entries.content: treasures = hidden [treasures, or stores].

entries.title: the pit:
entries.content:
the pit: or, cistern. Not mentioned elsewhere, but see 1 Kings 15:22 and 2 Chronicles 16:6 .

because of = besides.

was it. By regrouping the letters, this reads "[was] a large pit which", &c.

entries.title: the king's daughters.
entries.content:
the king's daughters. See note on Jeremiah 43:7 .

Nebuzaradan. See note on Jeremiah 39:9 .

the guard = the executioners (2 Kings 25:8 ).

entries.title: evil
entries.content: evil = calamity. Hebrew. ra'a'. App-44 .

entries.title: Gibeon.
entries.content: Gibeon. Now e l Jib , about five miles north of Jerusalem, where Joab treacherously slew Amasa (2 Samuel 20:8 , 2 Samuel 20:10 ).

entries.title: cast about
entries.content: cast about = turned round.

entries.title: eight.
entries.content: eight. Two had been slain in the encounter above.

entries.title: habitation
entries.content:
habitation = Khan , or inn. Hebrew. geruth. Occurs only here. Probably erected by Barzillai (2 Samuel 19:31-40 ). Near here was the inn where Joseph and Mary could find no room (Luke 2:7 ).

whom, &c. See Jeremiah 40:5 .

entries.title: Jezaniah.
entries.content:
As Jeremiah 41 records the infamous treachery of Ishmael, so Jeremiah 4 2 records the obstinate disobedience of Johanan. These incidents are recorded (instead of many others) because they show us something of the moral character of the People; and thus furnish us with the reasons for the calamities which overtook them.

Jezaniah. In Jeremiah 43:2 he has a second name, "Azariah". The Septuagint reads this name here.

entries.title: thy.
entries.content:
thy. A special various reading, called Sevir ( App-34 ), reads "our", as in Jeremiah 42:20 .

a few. Reference to Pentateuch (Leviticus 26:22 ).

as = according as.

entries.title: thy.
entries.content: thy. See note on Jeremiah 42:2 ; but here the reading "our" is supported by several codices and one early printed edition.

entries.title: behold.
entries.content: behold. Figure of speech Asterismos. App-6 .

entries.title: evil
entries.content:
evil = ill. Hebrew. ra'a'. App-44 .

that it may be well, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 6:3 ).

entries.title: The Thirty-Seventh Prophecy of Jeremiah
entries.content:
The Thirty-Seventh Prophecy of Jeremiah (see book comments for Jeremiah).

the LORD, the God of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 11:3 .

entries.title: build . . . pull you down . . . plant. . . pluck you up.
entries.content:
build . . . pull you down . . . plant. . . pluck you up. Compare Jeremiah 1:10 .

I repent Me. Reference to Pentateuch (Genesis 6:6 . Deuteronomy 32:36 ).

entries.title: saith the LORD
entries.content:
saith the LORD = [is] Jehovah's oracle.

I am with you. See the Structure, above.

entries.title: land
entries.content: land = soil.

entries.title: hunger of bread.
entries.content: hunger of bread. Which they had experienced.

entries.title: And now
entries.content:
And now = Now.

the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 7:3 . The same in Jeremiah 42:18 .

wholly set your faces. Reference to Pentateuch (Deuteronomy 17:16 ).

entries.title: afraid
entries.content: afraid = apprehensive.

entries.title: Go ye not into Egypt.
entries.content:
Go ye not into Egypt. This had ever been a standing command for Israel (Deuteronomy 17:16 . Isaiah 31:1 .Ezekiel 17:15; Ezekiel 17:15 ).

admonished = testified against.

entries.title: ye dissembled, &c.
entries.content:
ye dissembled, &c. None but Jehovah could know this. Compare Jeremiah 41:17 . Psalms 139:2 . Joh 1:48 ; John 2:24 , John 2:25 .

hearts = souls. Hebrew. nephesh.

entries.title: this day declared
entries.content: this day declared = declared this day. See note on Deuteronomy 4:26 .

entries.title: by the sword, &c.
entries.content: by the sword, &c. Reference to Pentateuch (Leviticus 26:6 , Leviticus 26:25 , Leviticus 26:33 , Leviticus 26:36 . Deuteronomy 28:22 ). App-92 .

entries.title: all.
entries.content:
all. Put by Figure of speech Synecdoche (of the Whole), App-6 , for the greater part, not all without exception.

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

entries.title: men.
entries.content: men. Plural of 'enosh. App-14 .

entries.title: Baruch.
entries.content: Baruch. A man of noble family (Jeremiah 32:12 ) suspected here. The reason may be found in Jeremiah 45:1-5 .

entries.title: whither, &c.
entries.content: whither, &c. Compare Jeremiah 40:12 .

entries.title: men.
entries.content:
men. Hebrew, plural of geber. App-14 .

children = young children.

person = soul. Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 .

Gedaliah. See note on Jeremiah 41:1 .

entries.title: Tahpanhes.
entries.content: Tahpanhes. An Egyptian fortress on the eastern or Syrian frontier of Lower Egypt (Compare Jeremiah 2:16 ), where the Pharaoh had his palace. See Jeremiah 43:9 . Now Tell Defenneh; where Petrie discovered (in 1886) a ruin called Kasr el Bint Yehudi = the palace of the daughter of Judah, assigned doubtless to the daughters of king Zedekiah. See Jeremiah 43:6 , above; and Jeremiah 41:10 . See App-87 .

entries.title: The Thirty-Eighth Prophecy of Jeremiah
entries.content:
The Thirty-Eighth Prophecy of Jeremiah (see book comments for Jeremiah).

Then = And. The Structure shows that a new member commences here.

entries.title: the brickkiln
entries.content: the brickkiln = the brick pavement before the royal palace. Laid bare in 1886 by Flinders Petrie. See note on 2 Samuel 12:31 . There could be no "brickkiln "close to the entrance of the palace. But such a platform is seen to-day outside all great, and most small, houses in Egypt. It is called mastaba, and is kept clean, and swept. Often made of beaten clay, edged with bricks. For this particular brickwork pavement, see App-87 . See note on Jeremiah 43:7 .

entries.title: the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel.
entries.content:
the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel. See note on Jeremiah 7:3 . The longer title is used to show the solemnity of the utterance.

Nebuchadrezzar . . . will set, &c. This was fulfilled to the letter. Josephus records it ( A n t . x. 9, 10), but Egyptian history is naturally silent. It took place five years after his destruction of Jerusalem.

entries.title: such as are, &c.
entries.content: such as are, &c. See note on 2 Samuel 12:31 .

entries.title: as
entries.content: as = according as.

entries.title: images
entries.content:
images = standing images, or obelisks. Probably Asherim. See App-42 .

Beth-shemesh. Hebrew = House (or Temple) of the Sun; Greek, "Heliopolis"; Egyptian, "On"; about ten miles northeast of Cairo.

that is in the land of Egypt. This is to distinguish it from the Beth-shemesh of Joshua 15:10 . Jdg 1:33 . 1 Samuel 6:9 , 1 Samuel 6:19 . See note on Isaiah 19:19 ; and App-81 .

entries.title: The Thirty-Ninth Prophecy of Jeremiah
entries.content:
The Thirty-Ninth Prophecy of Jeremiah (see book comments for Jeremiah).
